Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Without the grace of God, no one can be saved; all efforts are in vain without His help.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Where there is surfeiting, there the devils surely hold their choirs.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The devil will tell you that you are sinful, to make you despair. You should answer him abruptly saying: 'What's that to you? When I want to say that I am a sinner I will and not when the devil wishes'; because when the devil wishes he'll bring me to despair.

Author: Nikon of Optina
Quote: Do not forget prayer—it is the life of the soul.

Author: St. Gennadius of Constantinople
Quote: Adorn yourself with truth, try to speak truth in all things; and do not support a lie, no matter who asks you. If you speak the truth and someone gets mad at you, don't be upset, but take comfort in the words of the Lord: 'Blessed are those who are persecuted for the sake of truth, for theirs is the kingdom of Heaven.'

Author: St. Joseph of Optina
Quote: Never miss daily prayer. There is no excuse for not spending some of your time with God, for He is there for you always. Every day of missed prayer is a step backwards.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Man was made to rise, above curiosity and lust, to love, and through love to the attainment of truth.

Author: St. Luke of Simferopol
Quote: Drink Holy Water as often as possible. It's the best and most effective medicine. I say this not as a bishop, but as a doctor, from my experience in medicine.

Author: Schemaigumen Savva
Quote: You must not speak to anyone in a raised tone. If anger suddenly boils in your heat, you should know that it is from the devil, because from God there is always peace, silence, and calm in the soul.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: A small but persistent discipline is a great force; for a soft drop persistently hollows out even a rock.

Author: Abbess Aemiliane
Quote: Every thought is a thief that steals God from the mind.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: Whatever you do, do it gently and unhurriedly, because virtue is not a pear to be eaten in one bite.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: God will not accept empty words. God loves deeds. Good deeds are what love is.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous! Do not be terrified nor dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: You ask, will the heterodox be saved... Why do you worry about them? They have a Savior Who desires the salvation of every human being. He will take care of them. You and I should not be burdened with such a concern. Study yourself and your own sins.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: He who does not live in Christ already lives in the abyss, and not all of the treasures of this world can ever fill his emptiness.

Author: Fr. Pavel Florensky
Quote: There is only one way to understand Orthodoxy: through direct Orthodox experience... To become Orthodox, it is necessary to immerse oneself all at once in the very element of Orthodoxy, to being living in an Orthodox manner. There is no other way.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: The devil always drives us into despair, because depression is Satan's utmost joy.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Don't criticize or judge other people - regard everyone else as an angel, justify their mistakes and weaknesses, and condemn only yourself as the worst sinner…

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Even if you just lean your head on an Icon, you will find consolation

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The goal is to rise spiritually, not simply to avoid sin.

Author: St. Ambrose
Quote: The devil loves noise; Christ looks for silence.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: Every thought that brings despair and heavy sorrow is from the devil.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Many people have it all, but they also have sorrow because they haven't found Jesus Christ...

Author: St. Porphyrios of Kofsokalyvia
Quote: Let not us, who would be Christians, expect anything else from it than to be crucified.

Author: St. John of Karpathos
Quote: A great effort and much time are needed in prayer, before through struggle we can reach a state in which our mind is no longer troubled, and so attain the inward heaven of the heart where Jesus dwells.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: To pray is to descend with the mind into the heart, and there to stand before the ace of the Lord, ever-present, all seeing, within you.

Author: St. Clement of Alexandria
Quote: Even if we speak with a low voice, even if we whisper without opening the lips, even if we call to Him only from the depths of the heart, our unspoken word always reaches God and God always hears.

Author: Patriarch Pavle (Serbian)
Quote: A person cannot choose the time in which he is born or lives; it is not up to him, who his parents are, or the nation he will be born into, but what he is responsible for is how he will act in that given time: will he be human or inhuman?

Author: St. Tikhon of Zadonsk
Quote: An excellent faster is he who restrains himself from every impurity, who imposes abstinence on his tongue and restrains it from idle talk, foul language, slander, condemnations, flattery, and all manner of evil speaking, who abstains from anger, rage, malice and vengeance, and withdraws from every evil.

Author: St. Nektarios of Aegina
Quote: When you pray, try to mentally embrace the feet of Christ, like the sinful woman. Do not abandon prayer. Fear negligence. If you pray in the morning with devotion, you will 'fly' all day. But if you go without prayer, the whole day will be off.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: When I entered the Orthodox Church, something in my heart told me, you are home, the search is over!

Author: St. Ignatius Brianchaninov
Quote: Study the Holy Fathers of the Orthodox Church and not the western lunatics.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The Devil fears not those who know much, but those who pray much. He fears simple, yet fervent hearts that burn with love for God.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: A man should pray that God grant him, the possibility of doing a kind act, or say a kind word. Every good deed comes from God, and without Him, men cannot do them.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: ...Dispassion is nothing else than the inner heaven of the mind, where the tricks of demons are regarded as mere toys. And so the truly passionless one is he who has raised his mind above created things and has subdued all of his senses, keeping his soul in God's presence, always reaching out to Him even beyond his strength....He who has been granted such a state, while still in the body, has God always dwelling within him as his Guide in all his words, deeds, and thoughts.

Author: J.R.R. Tolkien
Quote: For myself, I find I become less cynical rather than than more, remembering my own sins and follies; and realize that men's hearts are not often as bad as their acts, and very seldom as their words.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: Anger, when properly controlled, serves as a tool for the righteous, but unchecked, it becomes a source of destruction.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Never confuse the person, formed in the image of God, with the evil that is in him: because evil is but a chance misfortune, and illness, a devilish reverie. But the very essence of the person is the image of God, and this remains in him despite every disfigurement.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: It is better to pray devoutly for your neighbor than to rebuke him every time he sins.

Author: St. Nikolaj Velimirovic
Quote: God did not send you to earth to live comfortably, rather to prepare for eternal life.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: Whoever hammers a lump of iron, first decides what he is going to make of it, a scythe, a sword,d or an axe. Even so we ought to make up our minds what kind of virtue we want to forge or we labor in vain.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: When the soul is subjected to temptation, it is like a ship tossed about by the waves; it is not easy to remain stable.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Why does man grow spiritually through pain and not through joys and rest? Simply because joy and comfort lead man to be satisfied with the present world. Grief and tribulations lead us to search for a deeper joy, beyond the limits of this life.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: We baptize even infants, though they are not defiled by sins, so they too may be given holiness, righteousness, adoption, inheritance, brotherhood in Christ, and membership in Him.

Author: St. Sofian Boghiu
Quote: When you are busy taking care of others, God will take care of you.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: Our life depends on the kind of thoughts we nurture. If our thoughts are peaceful, calm, meek, and kind, then that is what our life is life is like.

Author: Abba Dorotheos
Quote: No matter what kind of sorrow comes to you, don't blame anyone but yourself, and say, 'This has happened because of my sins.'

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: If the enemy decides to attack you with lustful thoughts, don't be put off by it, but use the demon for your own benefit saying: 'It is good that you have brought me these thoughts, now I am encouraged to pray otherwise I keep forgetting to pray unceasingly.' Right away the enemy will retreat.

Author: Fr. Alexander Elchaninov
Quote: Every sort of prayer is valuable, even inattentive prayer. The power and action of the word are independent of the psychological state of the person who utters it. If an injurious or obscene word pollutes and wounds the soul both of him who speaks and of him who hears, the sacred words of prayer, even if repeated absentmindedly, cover our memory, mind, and heart with a network, and have a beneficial effect on us of which we ourselves are unaware.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: Satan's whole concern is to convince man that God does not care about him.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: [One May] repress the violent and frenzied movements of the soul by thinking of the example of holy men.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Today we face so many dangers. God is watching over us like a mother watching every step of her child when it starts walking. Today, more than ever before, Christ, the Panagia, and the Saints are by our side helping us. But we do not realize it.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: Don’t be troubled if you don’t feel the love of God in yourself, but think about the Lord, that He is merciful, and guard yourself from sins, and the grace of God will teach you.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Always remember Jesus so that in all your weaknesses you may find the appropriate medicine.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: Acquire a peaceful spirit, and around you thousands will be saved.

Author: St. Nikolia Velimirovich
Quote: If ninety-nine of us are good and saintly but one of our brothers is far from our solace and support, in sin and darkness, be sure God is not among the ninety-nine, but He has gone to find our brother...

Author: St. Macarius the Great
Quote: But if a man goes his way in this life with slackness and carelessness...and, to please himself, will not turn away from all the lust of the world, and will not seek the Lord, and Him alone...he is pierced on the thorns and thickets of this world, and the garment of the body is burned by the fire [of passions].

Author: Fr. Pimen Vlad
Quote: God does not need our success. He needs our faithfulness.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: The devil does not destroy a man with one blow, but he whispers: 'Tomorrow, tomorrow' And so the heart is lulled to sleep, and the soul forgets eternity. But the wise man says, 'Today is the day of salvation,' and he rises to repent while there is still time.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: Neither heaven nor earth will receive those who are self-willed. God has a Divine plan for each one of us, and we must submit to His plan. We must accept life as it is given to us, without asking, "Why me?" We must know that nothing on earth or in heaven ever happens without the will of God or His permission.

Author: Elder Iustin Pârvu
Quote: We must bear the weakness of our brother to bring him relief. This sacrifice for our brother is greatly loved by God.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: God arranges for us to meet certain people so that we could pass on the good given to us by God and enrich each other's souls. The devil will try to do everything to make sure these meetings become useless and even harmful. Keep this in mind!

Author: St. Sisoes the Great
Quote: When someone learns to acknowledge every man as being better than himself, the man has attained humility.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: Men are often called intelligent wrongly. Intelligent men are not those who are erudite in the sayings and books of the wise men of old, but those who have an intelligent soul and can discriminate between good and evil.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: For God does not look at the quantity of our struggles, but examines the intention and the discernment with which we work, and He pours out His good, great, and abundant mercy accordingly...

Author: Fr. Andrei Lorgus
Quote: If a person gets into conflicts too often, it means he has an internal conflict with himself. Most often, this happens when a person feels that he is much worse than he would like to be. This causes tension and irritation within himself, which he takes out on others at the slightest provocation. Frequent criticism of others is a way of self-assurance.

Author: St. Nikon of Optina
Quote: If you say something evil about your brother or sister, even if it is true, your soul suffers an unhealable wound. You can reveal the sins of another only when the sole intention in your heart is the benefit of the soul of the sinner.

Author: Abbess Makrina
Quote: Forgive immediately! Not one second later, not even half a second later. For if you delay to forgive, jealous enters through the door, and then come hatred and envy. Forgive instantly, just as Christ forgives instantly. Never be angry; never allow anger to enter your heart. Every anger is from the devil. Do not let the devil into your heart. Only let Jesus into your heart by forgiving everyone instantly, and always blaming yourself.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: Never seek to correct each other with anger, but only with humility and sincere love, because one temptation does not cast out another temptation.

Author: St. Sophrony of Essex
Quote: When someone is psychologically ill, it is not simply his so-called subconscious that is sick, but his nose, which is the eye of the soul. Orthodox Hesychia is the unerring method for curing man.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: If anyone laughs at your faith, pray for him. There will be no laughing matter on the day of judgement.

Author: St. Anthony of Optina
Quote: Emotional peace is obtained from perfect devotion to the will of God, without which nothing exists.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: We must love everyone regardless of whether or not they love us; that is their business.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: The Christian has no reason to have in his heart any ill feelings whatever against anyone. Such ill feeling, like every other evil, is the work of the devil. The Christian must only have love in his heart. And as love cannot think of evil, he cannot have any ill feeling against others.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: The soul that loves God has its rest in God and in God alone. In all the paths that men walk in, in the world, they do not attain peace until they draw nigh to hope in God.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: Every day before you go to sleep, make a private confession to the Lord of everything in which you have sinned. Lying down to sleep is like departing for the other world.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: We must try to always be in good spirits and joyful, for the demons want us to be sad all the time.

Author: Abba Evagrius
Quote: Vainglory is the most subtle [passion] of them all.

Author: St. Ephrem the Syrian
Quote: Repent. Do not wait for tomorrow, for you do not know if you will see the sun rise.

Author: Elder Gervasios of Mt. Athos
Quote: The main cause of the problems…is that you have come to love the filth you carry within yourself and expect someone else to clean that filth out of you. And when someone tries to do so, you fall into fits of hysteria and rage. The problem is selfishness, egoism, and utter cowardice…You prefer to live in agony and self-pity rather than…live the life…that God intended for you when He created you.

Author: St. Ephraim the Syrian
Quote: Begin each year not with the noise of the world, but with silence of the soul—seeking Christ, and all will be well.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: The person who abides in solitude and quiet is delivered from fighting three battles: hearing, speech, and sight. Then there remains one battle to fight—the battle of the heart.

Author: St. Gregory of Nyssa
Quote: It is impossible for one who ha turned in his thought to this world, and who worries about it, and who busies himself with pleasing men, to fulfill the first and great commandment which says: Love God with thy whole heart and strength.

Author: St. Luke (Voyno-Yasenetsky)
Quote: I haven't actually seen God. But I have performed many brain surgeries, and when I opened the skull, I never saw a mind in there either. And I never found a conscience there either.

Author: St. Innocent of Alaska
Quote: Truly, not a single earthly pleasure can satisfy our heart. We are strangers on earth, pilgrims, and travelers; our home and fatherland is in heaven, in the heavenly kingdom; and there does not exist on earth things that could perfectly satisfy our desires.

Author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
Quote: To love someone means to see them as God intended them.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: When a person allows everything to pile up within him—whether it has been thrown at him by the devil, caused by the 'old man,' or born of the passions—and does not clean it all out through confession, he will never be able to obtain the precious health and salvation of his soul. Confessing everything frankly with humility removes everything unhealthy from within. After one's soul is washed with the tears of repentance, the grace of God comes, his thoughts are illumined, and he acquires health of soul.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: The bread you do not use is the bread of the hungry. The garment hanging in your wardrobe is the garment of the person who is naked. The shoes you do not wear are the shoes of the one who is barefoot. The money you keep locked away is the money of the poor. The acts of charity you do not perform are the injustices you commit.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Christ is the only exit from this world; all other exits—sexual rapture, political utopia, economic independence—are but blind alleys in which rot the corpses of the many who have tried them.

Author: Metropolitan Daniil
Quote: If we want a change to happen in society, a change must occur in the soul of the individual.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: The sick one who is acquainted with his sickness is easily to be cured; and he who confesses his pain is near to health. Many are the pains of the hard heart; and when the sick one resists the physician, his torments will be augmented.

Author: St. Iakovos of Evia
Quote: Never listen to what the world says

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The devil does not hunt after those who are lost; he hunts after those who are aware, those who are close to God.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: When there are two warring sides, one side has to back down for the sake of peace. We are that side. The Lord has, after all, commanded us to love our enemies.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: There are no coincidences in life. All things are providential. They are allowed for our salvation, in correspondence with our inner state and needs.

Author: St. Ephraim of Katounakia
Quote: If I read a hundred prayers in the silence of Athos a day, and you, in the noise of the city, with work and family responsibilities, read three prayers, then we are in the same position.

Author: Fr. Pimen Vlad
Quote: Every person bears the image of God. It is not limited to the Orthodox, all of creation reflects the image of God.

Author: St. Ignatius Brianchaninov
Quote: The road to hell is paved with tolerance of small sins.

Author: Pope Shenouda III
Quote: Remember always that you are a stranger on the earth and that you will return to your heavenly home. Then you will not put all your hopes in this world and its comforts.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: When you are praying alone, and your spirit is dejected, and you are wearied and oppressed by your loneliness, remember then, as always, that God the Trinity looks upon you with eyes brighter than the sun; also all the angels, your own Guardian Angel, and all the Saints of God.

Author: St. Maximus the Confessor
Quote: The new year is a reminder that we are drawing closer to the Kingdom of God. Let us live with this hope, so that each day may bring us closer to God.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: As long as there are holy people on earth, the earth will stand. If the art stops producing Saints, then it will come to an end.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: Do not say 'I can't.' This is not Christian. A Christian would say: 'I can, but not by myself, only through Christ Who strengthens me.'

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: Anger is the sinew of the soul when it is allied with the reason against sin.... Unless your anger has been aroused against the Evil One, it is impossible for you to hate him as fiercely as he deserves. For our hatred of sin should be as intense as our love for virtue. Anger is very helpful in bringing this about so long as it closely follows the guidance of the reason, being quiet, docile, and readily obedient to the call of reason... Such, then, is the advantage of anger if one knows how to control it.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Satan's handiwork is to constantly put malicious and damaging thoughts in people's minds.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: We must learn to ease the burden of thoughts that bears down upon us. As soon as we feel burdened, we must turn to the Lord and give our worries over to Him, as well as the worries and cares of our loved ones. I always give my problems over to the Lord, as well as the problems of those that come to me. I give them over to the Lord and His Most Holy Mother, and they take care of everything. As for me, how can I help others when I cannot even help myself?

Author: Fr. Sergei Bulgakov
Quote: Resurrect, Christ, in Your people, shine with Your truth the darkness of the devil enmity of man to man and of tribe to tribe, squander the enemies of Your work, incinerate our sluggishness and cold indifference, ignite and burn our hearts with Your fire.

Author: Elder Iliy Nozdrin
Quote: Do not make your life complicated—it is already wisely arranged. Believe in God and do not be afraid. What is yours will come, what is not will pass. Live with peace in your heart, not with fear in your thoughts. And you'll see—everything will end better than you could have imagined.

Author: St. Theodore the Studite
Quote: This is the sum of the mystery: to be corpses to the world but alive to God.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: People who are really brave are those who never despair.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: It is better to pray with reverence for someone, than to provide advice and critique for every problem that this person may have.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Often this demon [of lust] goes away altogether for awhile, and one can have a false sense of security that one is 'above' this passion: but all the Holy Fathers warn that one cannot consider this passion conquered before the grave. Continue your struggle and take refuge in humility, seeing what base sins you are capable of and how you are lost without the constant help of God Who calls you to a life above these sins.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: Woe to you, when all people speak well of you, for so their fathers did to the false prophets.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: People want to be cured, which is why they cry: 'Lord Jesus Christ, have mercy upon me.'

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: When you fall into despair, when you murmur and cannot bear temptation, then instead of victory you must constantly repent—repent for the faults committed during the day, and for negligence during the night. For otherwise, instead of receiving grace upon grace, your anguish will only increase. Therefore, do not be afraid and do not shrink back from temptations. Even if you fall many times, rise up again. Do not lose your composure and do not despair. These trials are like clouds, and they too will pass.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: Whoever wants to approach prayer without a guide, and proudly thinks that he can learn from books, and won't go to an elder, is already halfway into delusion. But the Lord helps the humble, and if there is no experienced guide, and he goes to a confessor, whoever he may be, then the Lord will cover him because of his humility.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: The goal is a perfect peacefulness, even in the middle of the raging storm.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: When a person takes one step to God, then God makes a thousand steps towards him.

Author: St. Paul the Apostle
Quote: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.

Author: St. Patrick of Ireland
Quote: Christ be with me, Christ within me, Christ behind me, Christ before me, Christ beside me, Christ to win me, Christ to comfort me and restore me, Christ beneath me, Christ above me, Christ in quiet, Christ in danger, Christ in hearts of all that love me, Christ in mouth of friend and stranger.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Patience is the one and only diamond which beautifies the Christian and makes straight the rough road of our salvation.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: For everything you think of doing, remember to say 'God willing.'

Author: St. Ephraim of Katounakia
Quote: Obedience to one's spiritual father will bring all things. Obedience will bring grace. Even the smallest disobedience drives away grace. The spiritual father is, in a certain way, in the place of God. Whatever the spiritual father says is as if spoken from the mouth of God.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: The Lord is known through the Holy Spirit, and the Holy Spirit fills our whole being: soul, mind, and body. This is how God is known, in heaven and on earth.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Orthodox Christianity stands apart from and opposed to every one of the world's religions; the Orthodox Church alone preaches the complete truth of God's purpose for man and provides the sufficient means for attaining it. Only in and through the Orthodox Church is eternal life in God, deification, possible. Ignorance or rejection of this truth and these means is not an indifferent manner; it is a matter of spiritual life or death, of salvation or damnation.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Atheist, true 'existential' atheism burning with hatred of a seemingly unjust or unmerciful God, is a spiritual state; it is a real attempt to grapple with the true God ... Nietzsche, in calling himself Antichrist, proved thereby his intense hunger for Christ.

Author: Metropolitan Kallistos Ware
Quote: If Orthodoxy doesn't make you kinder, it's just folklore.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Orthodox Christians! Hold fast to the grace which you have; never let it become a matter of habit; never measure it by merely human standards or expect it to be logical or comprehensible to those who understand nothing higher than what is human. Let all true Orthodox Christians strengthen themselves for the battle ahead, never forgetting that in Christ the victory is already ours.

Author: St. Nektarios of Aegina
Quote: A Christian must be courteous to all. His words and deeds should breathe with the grace of the Holy Spirit, which abides in his should, so that in this way he might glorify the name of God. He who regulates all of his speech also regulates all of his actions. He who keeps watch over the words he is about to say also keeps watch over the deeds he intends to do, and he never goes out of the bounds of good and benevolent conduct. The graceful speech of a Christian is characterized by delicateness and politeness.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Everything that is best, most exalted, most precious, holy, and wise, is found in the Church. In the Church is the ideal of mankind; the Church is heaven upon earth.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: Don't be sad, my child. Don't worry so much. Even though you have fallen again, get up again. You have been called to a heavenly road. It is not surprising for someone running to stumble. It just takes patience and repentance at every moment.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: If you have sinned, acknowledge the sin and repent. God will forgive the sin and once again give you a near heart...and a new spirit. There is no other way. Either do not sin, or repent.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Pay attention carefully. After the sin comes the shame; courage follows repentance. Did you pay attention to what I said? Satan upsets the order; he gives the courage to sin and the shame to repentance.

Author: Elder Aimilianos of Simonopetra
Quote: There are two paths that lead to God: the hard and debilitating path with fierce assaults against evil, and the easy path of love. Choose love!

Author: St. Basil of Caesarea
Quote: Do not say, 'this happened by chance, while this came to be of itself.' In all that exists there is nothing disorderly, nothing indefinite, nothing without purpose, nothing by chance... How many hairs are on your head? God will not forget one of them. Do you see how nothing, even the smallest thing, escapes the gaze of God?

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Orthodoxy is the Church founded by Christ for the salvation of mankind.

Author: Elder Aimilianos of Simonopetra
Quote: It is a fearful thing that we pray to God to change our situation, not realizing that He has sent it exactly as it is in order to change us.

Author: St. Sophrony of Essex
Quote: Silence is not the absence of noise. It is the presence of God.

Author: Abba Sisoes
Quote: A young monk said: 'Abba, I fell.' The elder answered: 'Get up!' 'I got up and fell again!' 'Get up again!' 'For how long?' 'Until your death.'

Author: St. Tikhon of Zadonsk
Quote: Christians weep now, but later laugh and rejoice.

Author: St. Nektarios of Aegina
Quote: A Christian must be polite with everyone... A Christian's grace-filled speech is characterized by sensitivity and politeness. This is what gives birth to love, and brings peace and joy. On the contrary, rudeness gives birth to hatred, enmity, [and] grief.

Author: St. Photios the Great
Quote: Abolition of small things which have been received through tradition will lead to complete contempt for the dogmas.

Author: St. Nikolai Velimirovic
Quote: If you run away from God, He will not chase you, but He will be waiting for you.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: If one becomes angry with one's neighbor on account of riches, fame, or pleasure, one does not yet realize that God orders all things with justice.

Author: St. Ephraim the Syrian
Quote: If you give all your life to the earth, the earth will give you a tomb; but if you give your life to heaven, heaven will give you a throne.

Author: St. Hadji-Georgis the Athonite
Quote: The Jesus Prayer is a sword that cuts every passion; hold it without ceasing and you will conquer.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: The water, through the prayer of the Church, receives the grace of God, and becomes holy, healing both the soul and body, and expelling every demonic influence from our homes.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: The precious Blood of Christ, which if received with full confidence, will have the power to extinguish every disease. Together with this, the careful hearing of the divine Scriptures and the giving of alms will enable us to do battle with the passions. Then, and then only, shall we live: for now surely we are in no better state than those who are dead, because while passions live in us, we cannot live.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: Be humble and loving before all people, and if you cannot love everyone, at least treat everyone with good will.

Author: St. Maximos the Confessor
Quote: To the extent that you pray with all your soul for the person who slanders you, God will make the truth known to those who have been scandalized by the slander.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: Try to be virtuous not only in your person, but counsel your wife, children, and in every good and God-pleasing deed. Avoid not only doing what is bad before them, but even say­ing it, lest you accustom them to evil. Thus God’s bless­ing shall rest on your house.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: Those who have truly decided to serve the Lord God should practice the remembrance of God and uninterrupted prayer to Jesus Christ, mental saying: 'Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.'

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: If you give something to one in need, let the cheerfulness of your face precede your gift, and comfort his sorrow with kind words. When you do this, by your gift, the gladness of his mind surpasses even the needs of his body.

Author: St. Isaac of Syria
Quote: The soul is a rare and precious thing, which cannot be saved without the grace of God, and yet it is often cast aside.

Author: St. Arsenie Boca
Quote: God's love for the biggest sinner is greater than the love of the holiest man for God.

Author: Fr. John Krestiankin
Quote: We have been commanded by our Lord to love our neighbor as ourselves, but it is none of our business whether they love us or not! The only thing for us to worry about is to make sure we truly love them!

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: The one who gets up and continues on after each fall reaches paradise.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: We suffer because we have no humility and we do not love our brother. From love of our brother comes the love of God.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: May God forgive me, but the world has become a huge madhouse. No one thinks of the next life anymore. All they want is more and more material goods. This is why they cannot find peace and run around constantly.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: They go to church and stand there readily, but they do not make the effort to stand with their mind before God continuously and to reverently fall down before Him. Having prayed a bit, they release the reins of the control of their mind; and it soars, circling over the entire world. As a result, they are externally located in church, but by their inner state they are not there.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: To become a slave to the pleasures of the table is to make the stomach one’s god.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Let each one, on returning home, call his own wife [or husband], and explain [their passions], asking for help....And though you fall once, twice, many times in your training, do not despair, but stand again, and wrestle. Do not give up until you have bound around your head the glorious crown of triumph over the Evil One, having stored up the riches of virtue in an inviolable treasure-house for the future life.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Even if we find ourselves with the devil or amongst the wild beasts, God is present. Neither the devil one the wild beasts are able to harm us if they do not have the authority from God to do so.

Author: St. Basil of Caesarea
Quote: Hell can't be made attractive, so the devil makes attractive the road that leads there.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: He, [God], always comes in time, but patience is necessary. He hears us immediately when we cry out to Him, but not in accordance with our own way of thinking. You think that your voice did not immediately reach the saints, our Panagia, and Christ. On the contrary, even before you cried out, the saints rushed to your aid... However, since you do not see beyond what is apparent and do not know how God governs the world, you want your request to be fulfilled like lightning. ... The Lord wants patience. He wants you to show your faith.

Author: St. Dorotheos of Gaza
Quote: Do not ask for love from your neighbor, for if you ask and he does not respond, you will be troubled. Instead, show your love for your neighbor and you will be at rest, and so will bring your neighbor to love.

Author: Elder Sophrony Sakharov
Quote: You don't need to be polite with God, simply pour out your heart before Him.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: Love is the most powerful means of defense there is. There are no weapons and no power that can measure themselves against love.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: When we gaze at our own failings, we see such a morass of filth that nothing in another can equal it. That is why we turn away, and make much of the faults of others. Instead of condemning others, strive to reach inner peace.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: Evil spirits are like vultures, they gather around the wounded soul, waiting for the moment to strike.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: He who desires to live piously must be vigilant, praying continually, lest he fall into the snares of the enemy.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: Forgetting offended is a sign of sincere repentance. If you keep the memory of them, you may believe you have repented but you are like someone running in his sleep. Let no one consider it a minor defect, this darkness that often clouds the eyes even of spiritual people.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Feeding the hungry is a greater work than raising the dead.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: Anger nurses a grievance. The soul, itching for vengeance, constantly tempts us to repay those who have offended us.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The more people distance themselves from a natural, simple life and embrace luxury, the more they suffer from anxiety. The result of worldly pleasures and self-indulgence is worldly anxiety.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Rich is not one who has a lot, but one who does not require anything.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Poverty serves us better than wealth, especially since wealth becomes an obstacle even for those who do not devote themselves to it. Yet, we must put aside our wrath, quench our envy, soften our anger, offer our prayers, and show a disposition that is reasonable, mild, kindly, and loving, how could poverty stand in our way? We accomplish these things not by spending money but by making the correct choice. Almsgiving requires money, but even this shines brighter when the alms are given from our poverty.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Have no concern for money. Love your wife more than you love your own life. Never be at odds, but be true. Prefer her company at home above being out. Esteem and admire her publicly, and advise her patiently. Pray together, go to church, and discuss the readings and prayers. If your marriage is like this, your perfection will rival the holiest of monks.

Author: St. Porphyrios of Kafsokalyvia
Quote: A Christian should avoid unhealthy religiosity: both the feeling of superiority due to virtue, and the feeling of inferiority due to sinfulness.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: The ladder that leads to the Kingdom is hidden within your soul: Flee from sin, dive into yourself, and in your soul you will discover the stairs by which to ascend.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: To know Christ died is history. To believe He died for me is salvation.

Author: Abba Dorotheos
Quote: Slander is when you reveal to others the sins and faults of your neighbor. For example, if you report that so-and-so told a lie, or got angry or fornicated or did something else bad. By doing so, you're already committing slander.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: An unhappy, angry person destroys everything, hurts even the closest and dearest people, while a kind person, creating peace and joy around them, restores what has been destroyed, comforts those who suffer, and helps those in need.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Pride is the military headquarters of all sin.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: It is truly alter that we think. The Apocalypse is now.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: ...And so let us be glad and bear with patience everything the world throws at us, secure in the knowledge that it is then that we are most in the mind of God.

Author: St. Athanasios of Parios
Quote: Do not listen to the 'lovers of wisdom'—who are in reality lovers of darkness—but to the divine apostles. Do not listen to the morally corrupt and the fornicators, but to the chaste, ascetic, and holy. Do not listen to those who are ignorant with regard to divine things, but to the divinely wise and spirit-bearers.

Author: St. Makarios the Great
Quote: So too you must become dead if you want to be saved. Pay no attention (like the dead) either to the injustice of folk or to their praise—then you can be saved.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: We advance toward humility by means of trials. He who rests on his virtue without suffering tribulation has the door of pride open before him.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: The primary goal in the education of children is to teach, and to give the example of, a virtuous life.

Author: St. Cleopa Ilie
Quote: We must first recognize that we all sin against God, some more than others, but no one is without sins.

Author: Bishop Gabriel
Quote: My brothers, have no fear of the punishments of the Lord! For He does not punish us as criminals, but as His own children!

Author: Elder Amphilochios of Patmos
Quote: When someone opens your heart, I'd like him to find nothing there but Christ.

Author: St. George of Drama
Quote: Prayer is your anti-devil weapon—never drop it!

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: Take care lest the Evil One tempt you into the sin of Adam and Eve… He who seduced Adam from Paradise by causing him to steal food… will be far colder with you in preparing this strong and poisonous drink.

Author: St. Nikolaj Velimirovic
Quote: A drop of prayer is worth more than a sea of worrying.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: We should never forget that our guardian angel is always invisibly beside us; he guards us and he protects us. But it is necessary that we are also careful in our lives and that we not sin.

Author: C.S. Lewis
Quote: Christianity, if false, is of no importance, and if true, of infinite importance. The only thing it cannot be is moderately important.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Look straight up to God: He will praise you. But the man whom He approves must not seek honor from mortals. Mortal honor often arises from flattery or hatred of others, and brings no profit....But God...brings great advantage to the man whom He approves. Therefore, let us seek after His praise.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: If you wish, you can be a slave of passions, and if you wish, you can remain free and not submit to their yoke; for God has created you with that power.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Happiness can only be achieved by looking inward and learning to enjoy whatever life has and this requires transforming greed into gratitude.

Author: St. Justin Martyr
Quote: To yield and give way to our passions is the lowest slavery, even as to rule over them is the only liberty.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: It is better for me to die in the fight, rather than to give up and let the way of God be blasphemed, since I have so many testimonies that all the saints passed through this road.

Author: St. Tikhon of Zadonsk
Quote: Prayer does not consist merely in standing and bowing your body or in reading written prayers... It is possible to pray at all times, in all places, with mind and spirit. You can lift up your mind and heart to God while walking, sitting, working, in a crows, and in solitude. His door is always open, unlike man's. We can always say to Him in our hearts: 'Lord, Lord have mercy.'

Author: St. Cyril of Jerusalem
Quote: The sign of the Cross is free. Use it like your life depends on it—because it does.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: The evils of our times are so great that sometimes we lose sight of the great power of what we have to oppose them with.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: Whenever it is a time of battling with Satan and of darkness, one should spend extra time in prayer and in kneeling on the ground

Author: St. Iakovos of Evia
Quote: Our sanctity depends on the glory and the grace of God and our union with Him, not on our virtues.

Author: King Solomon
Quote: But if your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in so doing you will heap burning coals on his head.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: If you leave church after the Liturgy without having forgiven everyone, you have left empty-handed.

Author: St. Porphyrios
Quote: Don't wage war on evil directly, but love Christ and His light, and evil will then retreat.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: The goal of our profession, as we have said, is the kingdom of God. Its immediate purpose however, is purity of heart, for without this we cannot reach our goal.

Author: Abbot Tryphon
Quote: Sit in a quiet place infant of an icon. Breathe quietly. Make peace in your thoughts and heart as much as you can. Leave your cares aside for `5 minutes. Start whispering the prayer: 'Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.' Listen as if someone else is saying [it].

Author: St. Alexis of Senaki
Quote: Everyone who loves God shows himself patient and steadfast in times of suffering... But whoever does not endure misfortune and afflictions has not faith, and whoever does not have faith, does not love God.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: No one is poorer than the sinner, and no one is richer than the individual who acts justly.

Author: St. Dorotheos of Gaza
Quote: The more one is united to his neighbor the more he is united to God.

Author: St. Abba Dorotheus
Quote: There are two kinds of gluttony. One is when a man seeks food that pleases him and does not always want to eat very much, but wishes to eat only what pleases his palate. Another is when a man is overcome by a tendency to eat much....He only wants to eat and eat, not minding what the food may be, only caring to fill his belly.

Author: Hieromonk Damascene
Quote: To be 'Orthodox but not Christian' is a state that has a particular name in Christian language: it means to be a phrase, to be so bogged down in the letter of the Church's laws that one loses the spirit that gives them life, the spirit of true Christianity.

Author: St. Marcus Eremita
Quote: It is harmful to remember previous sins in detail. For if they bring you sorrow, they will estrange you from hope, but if they are remembered without sorrow, they will introduce the previous defilement. If you want to bring to God an uncondemned confession, then don't remember your sins in detail, but manfully endure the suffering that is coming because of them.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: If we ourselves do not learn humility, God will not stop humbling us.

Author: St. Paul the Apostle
Quote: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and they glory in their shame, with minds set on earthly things.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: The spirit of God teaches the soul to love every living thing... the Spirit of God teaches love towards all, and the soul feels compassion for every being.

Author: St. Symeon the Theologian
Quote: One human being is more precious to God than the entire cosmos.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: God loves your effort, not your perfection.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: He who wishes to defeat the demon of fornication through gluttony is like a man who tries to put out a fire with oil.

Author: Unknown
Quote: A young masked asked the elder: 'Father, should I completely renounce the world now?' 'Do not worry,' replied the old man, ' if your life is truly Christian, the world will immediately renounce you.'

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: You pray little and complain a lot.

Author: St. Nikolaj Velimirovic
Quote: Every Liturgy is an atomic bomb dropped on hell.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: When a dark and hopeless thought comes, do not accept it as your own. Say: 'This is not my thought. This is the enemy's suggestion.' And then call upon Christ.

Author: Elder Iustin Pârvu
Quote: Now more than ever, lay people have to pray from the heart, because this will be our only salvation. In the heart is the root of all passions, and that is where we need to direct our struggles. If in the later years Christianity became lukewarm and superficial, we have to end all that now, this is not going to be enough anymore. If we will not pray from the heart, we will not be able to sustain the psychological attacks, because the evil one has hidden brainwashing methods that are unknown to us.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: Oh, if you only knew what joy, what sweetness awaits a righteous soul in Heaven! You would decide in this mortal life to bear any sorrows, persecutions, and slander with gratitude.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: When we patiently endure our problems and turn to God for help, we notice that He gives us the best possible solution.

Author: St. Ignatius Brianchaninov
Quote: Do not look for or expect love from others, rather demand from yourself love and compassion for them.

Author: Metropolitan John of Belgorod
Quote: We should start our day with prayer, not with news of what happened elsewhere. Moreover, we can no longer influence what has already occurred, but through prayer, we can influence the present. We will pray for the suffering, for the health of the wounded, and for the dead. By doing so, we turn to Christ and relieve ourselves of stress, for in prayer we connect with Him, the source of life.

Author: St. Gregory of Nyssa
Quote: The soul pulled down by the body can no longer look towards heaven.

Author: St. Ephraim of Katounakia
Quote: Leave everything to God, my child, and you will immediately see how peaceful you will be, how much joy you will feel immediately and how much comfort and peace you will find.

Author: St. Macarius of Optina
Quote: If you want to know how much pride you still have, count how many times a day you feel offended.

Author: Pishoy Kamel
Quote: The Saints are not humans without sin. They are humans who have struggled against sin.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Spiritual life begins when things seem absolutely 'hopeless'—that is when one learns to turn to God and not to our own feeble efforts and ideas.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: If God allows us to suffer, there will be some saving purpose behind it, which we mortals can't foresee.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Afflictions, illness, ill health, and pains that our bodies experience are counted for the remission of our trespasses. They are the furnace in which we are purified.

Author: St. Porphyrios
Quote: Don't wage your Christian struggle with sermons and arguments, but with true love. When we argue, others react. When we love people, they are moved and we win them over.

Author: St. Athanasius the Great
Quote: It is a fact, brothers and sisters, that the path of the saints in this life is one full of troubles.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgabadze
Quote: If you knew how much God loves you, you would cry from joy. Love is greater than any miracle. And humility is the throne of that love.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: There is no middle ground: either you are with Christ or you are with the spirit of the age.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: If you ever begin to think that you are spiritually 'well off,' then you can be sure that you aren't!

Author: St. Peter
Quote: Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: He who has become a lover of God and wishes to participate, however imperfectly, in the passionless-ness of God, in spiritual sanctity, serenity, quietness and meekness, and to taste the joy and gladness born of them, must strive to lead his thoughts far away from every passion which may trouble the soul, and contemplate Divine things with a clear and unclouded eye, insatiably enjoying the Divine Light.

Author: St. Poimen the Great
Quote: It may be that a man seems to be silent, but if his heart judges others, then he is always speaking.

Author: St. Paul the Apostle
Quote: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him. For God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.

Author: St. Nikolai Velimirovich
Quote: O Lord, awesome and just, prolong the days of the sinner, until he repents.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: My brother, sin resembles illness. You do not become sick only once. You repeatedly become sick with the same disease. Every time you become sick, you visit the doctor and take the medication he prescribes. Do the same thing for your soul. Every time you are injured—even if you are repeatedly injured in the same spot—repent and confess. At some point, the medicine of grace will completely cure your specific wound.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: When the fear of God exists within you, it means that your spirit is alive and that the grace of God is at work in you.

Author: Blessed Theophylact
Quote: For whether a person be gifted with speech, wealth, the authority of kingship, or any other power or skill, if you desire to benefit not only yourself but others as well you double [the skill] that has been given to you. But he who buries the talent is he who only cares for his own benefit and not for that of others, he is condemned.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: It is better to err by excess of mercy than by excess of severity... Do you will to become a Saint? Be severe to yourself but kind to others.

Author: St. Justin Popovich
Quote: Orthodoxy is not a library that you can study, but an experience that you are called to live.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: The Lord sometimes allows people who are devoted to Him to fall into such dreadful vices; and this is I n order to prevent them from falling into a still greater sin—pride. Your temptation will pass and you will spend the remaining days of your life in humility. Only do not forget your own sin.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: The path of God is a daily cross. No one has ascended into heaven by means of ease.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: In order to live harmoniously, couples need from the very start to set their love as the foundation of their life, a true and genuine love, one that is found in spiritual nobility, in sacrifice, and not in fake, worldly, and carnal love.

Author: Elder Savvas
Quote: You are obliged to forgive someone before someone asks you for forgiveness, if you are a Christian. And if he comes and says, 'I'm sorry,' so much the better for him. For you, if you are spiritually wise, it is the same, if not better, that he does not ask for forgiveness...

Author: St. Iakovos of Evia
Quote: Do not hope in the world. Be careful in your social interactions. Never listen to what the world is telling you. Temptations come; we're human. The devil has many feet, altars, and traps.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: God gives us the strength to pursue the path of crucifixion, there is no other way to be Christian.

Author: St. Philaret of Moscow
Quote: Do not fear the storm; walk calmly amid the waves, trusting in God.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: Don't be cruel-hearted towards your brother, as all of us can he defeated by evil thoughts.

Author: St. Ephraim the Syrian
Quote: Do good to both your own and to strangers as much as you can, and speak a kind word to both the good and the evil people.

Author: St. Tikhon of Zadonsk
Quote: As a bird without wings, as a solider without arms, so is a Christian without prayer.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: Silence is the cross on which we must crucify our ego.

Author: St. Macarius the Great
Quote: [We] need sobriety in all things, so that the good things that we appear to have may not turn to our harm...[so that] those who have wisdom are not deceived by their wisdom. A man must be well-tempered in everything, joining kindness with severity, wisdom with discretion, word with deed, trusting in the Lord in all things, not in himself. For virtue is seasoned with many different spices, just as food is often seasoned with pepper as well as honey.

Author: St. George Karslides
Quote: God cares for everyone. Despair is in effect a lack of faith.

Author: St. Ambrose of Optina
Quote: Throughout the day, try to remember God more often. If you feel bad, turn to Him: 'Lord, I feel bad, help me.' If you feel good: 'Lord, glory to You, thank You for this joy.' If you are worried about someone: 'Lord, I am worried about him, help him.' Whatever happens, turn it into prayer.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: Your job is to work upon yourself: for this you are chosen; the rest is in the hands of God. He who humbles himself shall be exalted.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: The world is in a terrible spiritual state, and only a return to genuine Christianity can save it.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Completely have trust in God, leave everything in His hands, and believe that His love will act for your own benefit. Everything is easy for Him, the difficult thing is for man to decide to humble himself and leave everything to God's divine providence and love.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: The sun of righteousness with healing in its wings has arisen.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: Do not be anxious about what will happen tomorrow. The same God who takes care of you today will take care of you tomorrow.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Those who were raised Orthodox from childhood have patience, but lack zeal. The converts have zeal, but lack patience.

Author: St. Porphyrios of Kofsokalyvia
Quote: If evil comes to assault you, turn all your inner strength to good, to Christ. Pray, 'Lord Jesus Christ, have mercy on me.' He knows how and in what way to have mercy on you. And when you have filled yourself with good, don't turn any more towards evil.

Author: St. Sophrony Sakharov
Quote: Most people are not atheists. They just replaced God with their ego.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: Anger is very helpful in bringing this about so long as it closely follows the guidance of the reason, being quiet, docile, and readily obedient to the call of reason… Such, then, is the advantage of anger if one knows how to control it.

Author: St. Macarius of Optina
Quote: Do not allow the spark of discord and enmity to smolder. The longer you wait, the more the enemy tries to cause confusion among you. Be watchful, so that he does not mock you. Humility destroys all of his schemes.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: How can you believe, when you receive glory from one another and do not seek the glory that comes from God?

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: It is impossible for the mind not to be approached by thoughts, but it is in the power of every earnest man either to admit them or to reject them. As then their rising up does not entirely depend on ourselves, so the rejection or admission of them lies in our own power.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: When you pass a hostile sign the cross 3 times: one for the patients, one for their relatives, and one for yourself because you aren't there.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Pornography is the Devil's iconography.

Author: St. Nicodemus the Hagiorite
Quote: Without love for your neighbor, your mind cannot be enlightened by divine wisdom and love.

Author: Unknown
Quote: Real men and women lead their partners to Christ.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: To say that God turns away from the sinful is like saying that the sun hides from the blind.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Isn't it a pity to lose eternity for 5 minutes? That's how long a good confession takes.

Author: Abba Ammonas
Quote: The 'narrow and hard way' is this, to control your thoughts, and to strip yourself of your own will, for the sake of God. This is the meaning of the sentence, 'lo, we have left everything and followed you.

Author: Elder Sergei of Vanves
Quote: If you are captivated by carnal beauty, go to a cemetery and see what the end of such beauty is.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: When one prays and strives and there are no results, either egotism or pride are present. If we are humble and aware of our sinfulness, the good God will give us whatever we ask for in prayer.

Author: St. Athanasius the Great
Quote: Devils take great delight in fullness, and drunkenness and bodily comfort. Fasting possesses great power and it works glorious things. To fast is to banquet with angels.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Force yourself to pray. At first you will find it difficult; afterwards, however, the more you compel yourself, the more easily you will pray.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The animals can recognize your disposition when you approach them, if you intend to kill them or if you approach them with genuine love.

Author: Patriarch Pavle
Quote: Take care of your enemies and pray for them because they don't know what they are doing.

Author: Elder Aimilianos
Quote: Don't be afraid of the battles within, your wounds and traumas may seem like insurmountable obstacles, but every struggle is an opportunity for God's grace to work in you; every time you face your fear, God is there with you.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: Remember, when you speak, you give birth to the word, you have spoken the word, and it will never die, but will live until the Last Judgement. It will be with you at the Last Judgement and will be for you or against you.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Even if a righteous man falls a thousand times a day, he will rise again and it will be counted as a victory.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: When there is pride, faith is not active.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: He who endures patiently the trials of life shall be crowned with glory in the age to come.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Health is a great things, but what illness brings to a person is an even greater good... It brings spiritual wealth. God knows what is beneficial fore achieving of us, and accordingly gives us either health or illness.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: So in every test let us say: 'Thank you, my God, because this was needed for my salvation.'

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: Never say that God is just. If He were just you would be in hell. Rely only on his injustice which is mercy, love, and forgiveness.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: He who lends his arm to help his neighbor receives the Arm of God as his helper.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: The Savior began the work of our salvation with fasting. In the same way all those who follow in the footsteps of the Saviour build on this foundation the beginning of their endeavor, since fasting is a weapon established by God. Who will escape blame if he neglects this? If the Lawgiver Himself fasts, how can any of those, who have to obey the law, be exempt from fasting?

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Do not accept any false doctrine under the pretext of love...

Author: St. Tikhon of Moscow
Quote: The Church of Christ is the kingdom not of this world. It does not possess any of the attractions of the earthly world. it is persecuted and slandered. Yet it not only avoids perishing in the world but grows and defeats the world.

Author: St. Ephraim of Katounakia
Quote: You might not realize it when you're saying the Jesus Prayer, but the devil does, and it sears him.

Author: Elder Antonios Ghizas
Quote: Repentance is not to look downwards at my own shortcomings, but upwards at God's love.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Self-love must be eradicated. Every sin comes from the love of self. Sin always appears, or feigns to be, wish us well, promising us plenteousness and ease.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Often we don't realize that God allows our brother or sister to act badly toward us so that we can be helped, and so we become angry with them. And while we ask God for humility, we don't accept the opportunities He sends us to become humble, and we fret and fume. Normally, we should be grateful to the one who humiliates us, for he is our great benefactor.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: No cloud is formed without a breath of wind; and no passion is born without a thought.

Author: St. Porphyrios
Quote: The truth of Christ stresses that, if you praise a person, you make him an egotist. The egotist is burdened, and is guided by the devil and the evil spirit. This growing up in the midst of egotism, the first act is to deny God and to be an egotistical misfit in society.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Lust is a promise of warmth that leaves the heart cold.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: If your prayer doesn't end in tears or silence, keep praying.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: God is now allowing severe trials to come upon us. Hard times are approaching. We will face great temptations. ... We must take this seriously and begin to live a truly spiritual life. The circumstances are already compelling us—and will continue to compel us—toward spiritual struggle. Yet, it is far better if we do this willingly and with. joy, rather than with sorrow and compulsion. Many of the Saints would have wished to live in our times, so that they might struggle for Christ.

Author: St. Ephrem the Syrian
Quote: It is blasphemy if you pray before God while you are full of anger.

Author: St. Seraphim of Vyritsa
Quote: Surrender your life to God's will daily. He knows your needs better than you do.

Author: Abba Evagrius
Quote: Lust is extinguished by hunger.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: To Christians who are not Orthodox, we should not tell them that they will go to hell or that they are antichrists, but neither should we tell them that they will be saved.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The person that is struggling to the best of his abilities, who has no desire to live a disorderly life, but who—in the course of the struggle for faith and life—falls and rises again and again, God will never abandon. And if he has the slightest will not to grieve God, he will go to Paradise with his shoes on. The Benevolent God will, surprisingly, push him into Paradise. God will ensure that he takes him...in repentance. He may have to struggle all his life, but God will not abandon him; He will take him at the best possible time.

Author: St. Amphilochios of Patmos
Quote: A Christian who is offended is a Christian who forgot the Cross.

Author: St. Peter of Damascus
Quote: We are not punished for our sins. We are punished by them.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: All that is good and also all that is not, everything comes from our thoughts. Our thoughts determine our whole life. If our thoughts are destructive, we will have no peace. If they are quiet, meek, and simple, our life will be the same, and we will have peace within us. It will radiate from us and influence all beings around us—rational beings, animals, and even plants. Such is our 'thought apparatus,' which emits thoughts with which we influence all other beings. And everyone expects peace, consolation, love, and respect from us.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: The Lord loves us so much that He suffered for us on the Cross; and His suffering was so great that we can't comprehend it. In the same way our spiritual pastors suffer for us, although we often don't see their suffering. The greater the love of the pastor, the greater his suffering; and we, the sheep, should understand this, and love and honor our pastors.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: He who does things in order to please worthless men rather than for the sake of virtue...how can he be worthy of anything?...Is it not excessively ridiculous to seek the good opinion of those whom you would never wish to be like?

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Fasting without love is just a diet for proud people.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: When somebody curses your faith in your presence and you stay silent, you are worse than the blasphemer.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: All of us sin constantly. We slip and fall. In reality, we fall into a trap set by the demons. The Holy Fathers and the Saints always tell us, 'it is important to get up immediately after a fall and to keep on walking toward God.' Even if we fall a hundred times a day, it does not matter; we must get up and go on walking toward God without looking back. What happened has happened—it is in the past. Just keep on going, all the while asking for help from God.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: The fight against lust is the most painful and most serious struggle, and few are able to stand firm in this battle.

Author: St. Symeon the New Theologian
Quote: A man who has not become free from passions cannot know what passionlessness is, nor does he believe there can be anyone like this on earth. For if a man has not first renounced himself and has not exhausted his blood for the sake of this truly blessed life, how can he imagine that anyone else has been able to do it?

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: As with the appearance of light, darkness retreats; So, at the fragrance of humility, all anger and bitterness vanishes.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: The greatest gift of God, which we mostly need and which we very often obtain from God, through our prayers, is peace or rest of heart. As the Lord Himself says: 'Come unto Me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.' Therefore, having obtained this rest, rejoice, and consider yourself as rich and possessing all things.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: What are the aspects of pleasing men? The first, their mother, is lack of faith, and its offspring are: envy, hatred, flattery, jealousy, quarreling, hypocrisy, partiality, doing service only for show, calumny, lies, an air of false piety, and other such dark passions which are difficult to detect.

Author: St. Nikolaj Velimirovic
Quote: My whole life is a battle between me and me—between as I am and me as God wants me to be.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: My wife must be obedient, says the husband. But if you do not love, then even a cat won't obey you.

Author: St. Barsanuphius of Optina
Quote: As soon as you wake up, let the sign of the Cross be your first work, and the words of the Jesus Prayer be your first words.

Author: St. Nectarios of Aegina
Quote: God will not give you the people you want, but the people you need: to help you, to hurt you, to leave you, to love you, and to transform you into the person you were meant to be.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: …St. Paul consoles his hearers by saying ‘renew yourselves’ from day to day. This is what we do with houses: we keep constantly repairing them as they wear old. You should do the same thing to yourself… Do not despair, do not despond, but renew your soul by repentance, and tears, and Confession, and by doing good things…

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: Peace is promised to us in the future life, but here on earth—labor and temptation. Blessed is the man that endures temptation.

Author: St. Irenaeus of Lyons
Quote: One should not seek among others the truth that can be easily gotten from the Church. For in her, as in a rich treasury, the apostles have placed all that pertains to truth, so that everyone can drink this beverage of life. She is the door of life.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: I have found an unbeatable prayer that sends away anger, carnal, psychological temptations, and demons: 'Great it the name of the Holy Trinity, most Holy Theotokos protect us.'

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: If the family is destroyed, then states will be overthrown and peoples will be perverted.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: A government is secure insofar as it has God for its foundation and His will for its guide; but this is not a description of a Liberal government. It is, in the Liberal view, the people who rule, and not God.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: If a man’s deeds are not in harmony with his prayer, he labors in vain.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: We begin to conquer vainglory when we take custody of the mouth…when we call to mind the multitude of our sins...and when we recollect our death.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: There is nothing, nothing really, that a demon can do to a creature of God, unless we give them that right. Without that right, all they do I make noise. They have no authority.

Author: Fr. George Parsenios
Quote: Christ and His Church accepts everybody, but absolutely everybody is called to change.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: The Lord permits many disappointments, sorrows and misfortunes to befall us in this earthly life in order that we might stop placing our trust in the world, which harms us so much and that we might realize that He alone is the source of all comfort, peace and stillness.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Never lose hope of salvation. Constantly cry out to God and weep. God never overlooks a soul that wants to be saved and repents, no matter how much it may be wounded in the fight.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: God is love, and I am an image of God; therefore I ought to be all love. God is the most perfect good, free from the least shadow of evil; I am an image of God; therefore I ought also to be perfectly good, without even a shadow of evil.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: What I see around me would drive me insane,e if I did not know that no matter what happens, God will have the last word.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Are you oppressed by some worldly affair? Say: 'Enlighten me, my Jesus, how to deal with the matter which lies before me. Work it out in accordance with Thy holy will.' And behold, you will be at peace and will walk with hope.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Fear not the taunt and opinions of men, for this is of the Devil. Consider instead what the angels, saints, and God Himself say of you.

Author: St. Cyril of Jerusalem
Quote: Though remission of sins is given equally to all, the communion of The Holy Spirit is bestowed in proportion to each man's faith. If you have labored little, you receive little; but if you have wrought much, the reward is great. You are running for yourself, see to your own interest.

Author: St. Maximos the Confessor
Quote: Christ wants you never, in any way, for any reason, to cultivate a spirit of hatred, bitterness, angel, or ill-feeling. The four gospels proclaim that on every page.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: No matter how just your words may be, when you speak with anger, you ruin all: no matter how boldly you speak, how fairly reprove, or what not. ... Let us then be clean from wrath. The Holy Spirit dwellers not where wrath is: cursed is the wrathful.

Author: Abbot Tryphon
Quote: Pain isn't a sign that God has left you but that He is working on you. Sometimes He is silent, not because He isn't listening, but because He is teaching you to sit with yourself, hear your heart, and see how much you need Him. In this silence, patience is ripened, and love is purified.

Author: St. Ephraim
Quote: To have everything and not have Christ, you have nothing-to have nothing and to have only Christ, you have everything.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: Be good to your friends, kind to your dependents, tolerant to the rude, and generous to the despised.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Everything in this life passes away—only God remains, only He is worth struggling towards. We have a choice: to follow the way of this world, of the society that surrounds us, and thereby find ourselves outside of God; or to choose the way of life, to choose God.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgabadze
Quote: The devil has 666 traps. In the time of the Antichrist, people will be waiting for salvation from space. This will be the devil's greatest deception. Humanity will ask for help from aliens, not knowing that they are demons.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: Each of us can discuss God inasmuch as he has known the grace of the Holy Spirit; for how can we think of or discuss what we haven't seen, or haven't heard of, or don't know? ... The Saints speak of that which they have truly seen and know.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: The human spirit lies open to God alone, for it is a fathomless depth.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Modern men have faith in machines, in material well-being in the sustainability of all that seems obvious to common sense; this is a petty faith, the faith of petty men. The Christina has faith in God and the world to come, in the insubstantiality of all that is obvious, in the passing of this world and the coming of the new, transfigured world; if there is a faith of worthy men, it is surely this.

Author: St. John of Damascus
Quote: Therefore, the man who lives according to God must seek firstly those pleasures which are both necessary and natural. But those which are natural but unnecessary must be given second place in one's life and indulged in only as time, manner, and moderation allow. However, the others (those which are both unnecessary and unnatural) must absolutely be rejected.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: The least will become a thousand and the smallest a powerful people. I am the LORD; at the right moment, I will hurry it along.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Don't despair, no matter how much the passions may fight you, God loves the one who is fought against and fights back. Be brave.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: If you want to change the world, go home and love your family.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: Your tongue longs to jump into argument, but restrain it. It is a tyrant, and you must fight it daily seventy times seven.

Author: St. Nikolai Velimirovich
Quote: Just one repentant thought eases the wrath of God; for God is not angry at men as an enemy is angry, but His anger toward men is as that of a father toward his children. His anger is momentary and His mercy is infinite.

Author: St. Pachomios of Chios
