Quote: Whatever you do, if you do not have humility and, especially, love, it amounts to nothing. Virtue without humility is not virtue.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: You fast, but Satan does not eat. You labor fervently, but Satan never sleeps. The only dimension with which you can outperform Satan is by acquiring humility, for Satan has no humility.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Do you want your wife to obey you as the Church obeys Christ? Then care for her as Christ cares for the Church.

Author: St. Maximos the Confessor
Quote: A Christian receives divine wisdom in three ways: by the commandments, teachings, and faith. The commandments free the mind from passions. Teachings lead it to true knowledge of nature. Faith leads to the contemplation of the Holy Trinity.

Author: Elder Sophrony of Essex
Quote: The Divine Liturgy is the way we know God and the way God becomes known to us...Every Divine Liturgy is a Theophany. The Body of Christ appears. Every member of the Church is an icon of the Kingdom of God. After the Divine Liturgy we must continue to iconify the Kingdom of God, keeping His commandments. The glory of Christ is for Him to bear His fruit in every member.

Author: St. Cleopa Ilie
Quote: If you want peace in your soul, stop judging others and start judging yourself every evening.

Author: Abba Dorotheos
Quote: No one can say, 'I am poor and hence I have no means of giving alms.' For even if you cannot give as the rich gave their gifts into the temple treasury, give two farthings, and from you, God will consider it a greater gift than the gifts of the rich. And if you do not have that much? You can take pity on the sick and give alms by ministering to them. And if you cannot do even this? You can comfort your brother by your words. 'A good word is better than the best of gifts.'

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: There are three traps of Satan that steal joy and peace: regretting about the past, fear for the future, and ingratitude for the present.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: God is everywhere. There is no place God is not... You cry out to Him, 'Where art Thou, my God?' And He answers, 'I am present, my child! I am always beside you.' Both inside and outside, above and below, wherever you turn, everything shouts, 'God!'

Author: St. Cosmas Aitolos
Quote: Hell is full of people who meant to repent tomorrow.

Author: St. Porphyrios
Quote: God takes care of even the tiniest details of your life. He isn't indifferent to us, we aren't alone in the world.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Down here in this world we celebrate Holy Pascha for a very short time. This joy ends and is again succeeded by sorrows, distress, temptations, and so many other afflictions. Conversely, up there in the other world, Pascha will be eternal, without end, without sunset unto ages of ages.

Author: St. Poemen
Quote: Keep silence and do not always be comparing yourself with others.

Author: St. Makarios of Optina
Quote: Vigilance is the watchman's lamp, illuminating the soul against the night's temptations.

Author: Unknown
Quote: Thinking on bad thoughts at night doesn’t fix anything.

Author: Archimandrite Vasileios of Iveron
Quote: What am I supposed to do with a success that does not conquer death? Let all the failures come, just as long as death is conquered and this failed life of mine overflows even now with eternity.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: After our death, when we come face to face with Christ, we will understand the how and why of our lives and we will be told everything we went through in this world. Then, with all the power of our existence, we will say to Him, “Thank you, my God, for allowing these for me!

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: I used to think: 'Why does God send us affliction?', and then I realized—to break a stone you need a hammer. Many turn to God only through grief and sorrow.

Author: Ivan Alexandrovich Ilyin
Quote: A weak person blames all of his failures on his depressing traits which 'conspire' against him.

Author: St. Ambrose of Optina
Quote: Everyone is born at the time that is best suited for his salvation.

Author: St. Ephraim the Syrian
Quote: When a person is terminally ill, he often stops eating food. His friends and family know that death is near. In the same respect, when the angels see us refrain from the nourishment of prayer and the Eucharist... they begin to grieve, because they know that our souls are dying.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: To trust God is to rest in His hands, knowing the storm cannot sink the soul He holds.

Author: St. Maximos the Confessor
Quote: Do not say that faith in Christ alone can save you, for this is not possible if you do not attain love for Him, which is demonstrated by deeds. As for mere faith: 'The demons also believe and tremble.'

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: God wants us, above all, to be happy and to enjoy inner peace. God is not a tyrant who pesters and intimidates us, but instead he wants us to be free.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: It is easy to think in an Orthodox way... but to live in an Orthodox way requires effort.

Author: Fr. Pishoy Kamel
Quote: People don’t need to hear about Christ anymore, they have heard enough. They rather need to see Christ in us.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: Oh Lord, do not snatch me up while I am in the middle of my days, and do not take me while my lamp is extinguished, but have patience with me so that I may light my lamp with the oil of repentance.

Author: St. Alexandra of Hesse
Quote: We do not live to do the things that we please, but to do with love the things that we must

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: The best prayer is: 'Lord! You knowest all things. Do with me as Thou willest!'

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: Judge yourself as meriting any great rewards or think that any man is inferior to you. If you rid yourself of these two faults, anger will never be aroused in you, even when you suffer indignities... You must quiet your heart when it howls with rage. Compel your passions to honor the arrival of your reason, just as an ill-behaved boy respects the presence of a holy elder....We should keep [anger] curbed, just as we would a horse, by keeping it bridled to our reason, which then will lead it wherever it wishes.

Author: St. John Cassian
Quote: Just as a deadly plague destroys not just one member of the body, but the whole of it, so pride corrupts the whole soul, not just part of it... when the voice of pride has become master of our wretched soul, it acts like some harsh tyrant who has gained control of a great city, and destroys it completely, razing it to its foundations.

Author: Fr. Pimen Vlad
Quote: The soul has no room for hatred when it is filled with the Mother of God.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: If you give up on the Living God, the throne is not going to remain empty.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovinca
Quote: We must live through many misfortunes sorrows in order to learn how to rise above all these problems that disturb our inner peace.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: When having meals, remember those who are in need, hungry, thirst, suffering—in this way you will learn how to receive Divine Grace.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: It is not a sin to eat; it is a sin to eat without gratitude.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: If a person sincerely prays and does not receive what he asks for, then the Lord is preparing for him more and better than he asks for.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Learn to pray. Force yourself to pray. In the beginning it will be difficult, but afterwards, the more you force yourself, the easier it will be for you to pray. In the beginning it is always necessary to force oneself.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: The greatest gift of God is peace or rest of heart. As the Lord Himself says: 'Come unto Me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, d I will give you rest.' Therefore, having obtained this rest, rejoice, and consider yourself as rich and possessing all things.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Fear God—not the demons. Fear God and His judgments, for when He decides to punish us with some kind of penance for our pride, who is able to stop Him? Therefore, when the evil is still small, let us take care to remedy it. For once it has grown worse, you will not be able to be delivered even if others help you. So love God more, since He has sent you the medicine for your illness—that is, patience, humility, and courage—and see to it that you take it.

Author: St. Iakovos of Evia
Quote: Without our soul being pure, we gain no benefit from Holy Communion. That is why you should not hesitate, you should not be ashamed to confess.

Author: St. Macarius the Great
Quote: There is no need to make long prayers, but extend your hands and say, 'Lord, as you will and as you desire, lead me.' If the conflict is urgent within you, say, 'Lord, help.' He knows what is good for us, and He acts with mercy toward us.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: Other people's sins are not your business. Sit and cry for your sins.

Author: St. Athanasius
Quote: Orthodoxy is what Christ taught, the Apostles preaches, and the Fathers kept.

Author: St. Nektarios of Aegina
Quote: Don't let anything deprive you of hope.

Author: Elder Iustin Pârvu
Quote: Do not be afraid of the cross you carry. It is the way to resurrection.

Author: St. Cleopa
Quote: Without the Jesus Prayer you cannot overcome a single evil thought.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: So don't worry about these things, saying, 'What will we eat? What will we drink? What will we wear?' These things dominate the thoughts of unbelievers, but your Heavenly Father already knows all your needs. Seek the Kingdom of God above all else, and live righteously, and He will give you everything you need.

Author: St. Paul the Apostle
Quote: Put to death therefore what is earthly in you: sexual immorality, impurity, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

Author: Abbess Theosemni
Quote: We shouldn't be bothered with sins, nor should we think about them. We should confess them and then change course and deal with beautiful things instead.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: It is because we did not fast that we were banished from Paradise. So let us fast that we may return to it.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: The man who flees and lives in solitude is like a bunch of grapes ripened by the sun, but he who remains amongst men is like an unripe grape.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: In suffering, something goes on which helps the heart to receive God's revelation.

Author: Diadochus
Quote: This does not mean that one who is passionless never feels any passions. Passionlessness does not mean not being attacked by demons. Rather, passionlessness means remaining unconquered when attacked; just as armored warriors remain unharmed because of the strength of their armor, so too ourselves if we are clothed [with the armor of God].

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Sometimes your soul gets tested so bad that you wish you could die. It is easy to die, and does not take long; but are you prepared for death? Remember that after death the judgement of your whole life will follow. You are not prepared for death...

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: If you don't forgive, forget heaven.

Author: Mother Erene
Quote: No matter how tired we are during our life on earth, be it long or short, heaven is worth it. Let us mind our business and never judge anyone. Everyone should do what he is required to do in honesty, meticulousness, and the fear of God until the very end. We do not have time to see what others are doing or saying. A wise and rational person judges himself and does not get affected by dispraise or praise.

Author: Mother Gavrilia
Quote: If you don't like somebody, remember that you are looking at Christ in the face.

Author: St. Athanasius the Great
Quote: If the world is against the truth, then I am against the world.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: We must understand that the human person in reality does not die. Death is simply a transfer from one life to the other.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: When you can't solve a problem and don't know what to do, trust in Providence, live and don't think about it anymore.

Author: St. Ignatius Brianchaninov
Quote: Do not believe bother, that inner thoughts can be controlled without control of the body. Fear bad habits more than devils.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: God will not hear our prayers unless we acknowledge ourselves to be sinners. We do this when we ponder on our own sins alone, and not on those of our neighbor

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: God does not interfere in our lives, but waits for us to ask Him to help us, for He respects our freedom.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: God does not allow a trial unless something good comes out of it... God allows everything for our good.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: Cheerfulness is not a sin. It drives away weariness, and it is from weariness that despondency comes.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: Love every man in spite of his falling into sin. Never mind the sins, but remember that the foundation of the man is the same—the image of God.

Author: Righteous Alexis Mechev
Quote: Commune more often and don't say that you're unworthy. If you keep saying that, you'll never commune, because you'll never be worthy. Do you think there's even a single person on earth who is worthy of communing the Holy Mysteries? No one is worthy of it, but if we still combine, it's only due to God's special mercy. We're not made for communion, but communion is made for us. It's precisely we, the sinners, the unworthy, the weak, who needs this saving source more than anyone else.

Author: Fr. Pimen Vlad
Quote: Let us take care, but do not worry. Christian life means happiness, even in tribulations.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: As soon as the devil sees someone possessed of this weapon, [fasting], fear immediately falls on our adversary and tormentor, who remembers his defeat by the Saviour in the wilderness; his strength is at once destroyed, and the sight of the weapon, given us by our Supreme Leader, burns him up.

Author: St. Ephraim the Syrian
Quote: In the measure to which a man cuts off and humbles his own will, he proceeds toward success. But insofar as he stubbornly guards his own will, so much does he bring harm to himself.

Author: St. Nectarios of Aegina
Quote: You have not yet entrusted everything to Christ; but when you do, God is obliged to fulfill your desires in a way you do not know.

Author: St. Porphyrios of Kofsokalyvia
Quote: Do not seek peace in this world; you will not find it there. Seek Christ and you will have peace where ever you are.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: When you pray to our Lady the Holy Virgin, be firmly assured, before praying, that you will not depart from her without having received mercy. To this thus and to have confidence in her is meet and right. She is, the All-Merciful Mother of the All-Merciful God, the Word, and her mercies, incalculably great and innumerable, have been declared from all ages by all Christian Churches; she is, indeed, an abyss of mercies and bounties.

Author: St. Nicodemus the Hagiorite
Quote: When lustful thoughts begin to trouble you, immediately turn your mind to The Crucified One.

Author: St. Arsenie Boca
Quote: The devil is afraid of only one thing: a humble man who prays with tears.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Being men, we sin every day, but Saint Paul consoles us by saying ‘renew yourselves’ from day to day. This is what we do with houses: we are constantly repairing them as they break down. You should do the same thing to yourself.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Let all true Orthodox Christians strengthen themselves for the battle ahead, never forgetting that in Christ the victory is already ours.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: Throw your weaknesses before God, and the Lord will become your strength.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: True fasting lies in rejecting evil, holding one’s tongue, suppressing one’s hatred and banishing one’s lust, evil words, lying and betrayal of vows.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: So there is the solution to your puzzle: 'I do not know what to do with my life.' Look to Heaven, and measure every step of your life so that it is a step towards it.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: I know that our Guardian Angel intercedes for us and guides us. When we pray for someone, our Angel can help with the speed of lightning. He can warn or protect the one we are praying for.

Author: st. Porphyrios of Kavsokalyvia
Quote: When you find Christ, it's enough for you, you don't want anything else, you calm down. You become another person.

Author: St. Clement
Quote: The primary lesson for life must be implanted in the soul from the earliest age. The primary lesson for children is to know the eternal God, the One Who gives everlasting life.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: ...Know who you are in truth, and not who you imagine you are. With this knowledge you become the wisest man.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: Never look down on anyone. You do not know whether the Spirit of God prefers to dwell in your or in them.

Author: St. Porphyrios
Quote: Speak less, pray more.

Author: St. Katherine the Great Martyr
Quote: The tongue cannot recount the good things that God prepares for those who love Him and keep His commandments.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: And all these let us practice at home, with our friends, with our wife, with our children. And, for the present, let us begin with the first and easier things; for instance, with not swearing. Let us practice this one letter continually at home. For, in truth, there are many at home to hinder this our practice:...sometimes an annoying wife, sometimes an indocile and disorderly child, which urge us on to swearing...

Author: St. Justin Popovic of Celije
Quote: And when you fall into the most terrible sins the holy angels grieve for you and pray to the Heavenly Father. Remember that you are also an angel in the body, that you have a godlike soul like [the angels], and that it is shameful for you to be in hell, to be in darkness, to be among the demonic deformities. Shake yourself and awaken, arise from the dead!

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: If we would rise with Christ, we must first be humbled with Him—even to the ultimate humiliation, being devoured and spit forth by the uncomprehending world.

Author: Fr. Spyridon Bailey
Quote: When the flesh attacks… this is our opportunity for spiritual wisdom.

Author: St. Nikolaj Velimirović
Quote: A nation that forgets its saints will soon forget itself.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: When mothers pray, hell trembles; the most dangerous person on earth is a praying mother. Her children become flaming torches in God's hands.

Author: St. Isaac of Syria
Quote: The one who falls into temptation must rise again, for the way of the righteous is not without struggles.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: A time is coming when men will go mad, and when they see someone who is not mad, they will attack him, saying, ‘You are mad; you are not like us.'

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: A rich man is not one who has much, but one who gives much. For what he gives away remains his forever.

Author: St. John of Damascus
Quote: Briefly, we may say that in the nature of things, if someone wants to be saved, no person and no time, place or occupation can prevent him. He must not, however, act contrary to the objective that he has in view, but must with discrimination refer every thought to the divine purpose.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: Anger is the result of pride and vanity. Absolve it by love for all and true humility.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: If a person does not argue with the thoughts that the enemy secretly sows in us, but by prayer to God uproots conversation with them, this is a sign that his mind has attained wisdom, and that he has found a short path.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Thoughts are like airplanes flying in the air. If you ignore them, there is no problem. IF you pay attention to them, you create an airport inside your head and permit them to land!

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: Let mercy outweigh all else in you. A hard and unmerciful heart will never be pure.

Author: St. Sergius of Radonezh
Quote: If you want to serve God, prepare your heart not for food, not for drink, not for rest, not for ease, but for suffering, so that you may endure all temptations, trouble and sorrow.

Author: St. Porphyrios of Kofsokalyvia
Quote: Do you know what a great gift it is that God gave us the right to speak to Him every hour and moment, wherever we are? He always listens to us. This is the greatest honor we have. For this reason we must love God.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: If you want to help the Church, it is better to try to correct yourself, rather than be looking to correct others. If you manage to correct yourself, one small part of the Church is immediately corrected. Naturally, if everyone did the same, the body of the Church would be in good health.

Author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
Quote: Tolerance will reach such a level that intelligent people will be banned from thinking so as to not offend the imbeciles.

Author: St. Porphyrios
Quote: You don't become holy by fighting evil. Let evil be. Look towards Christ and that will save you. What makes a person saintly is love.

Author: Hieromartyr Daniel Sysoev
Quote: No number of negatives will ever add up to a positive, and however many deluded people one may assemble no truth will ever come out of their common delusions. It is not the will of the majority that is needed in order to learn the truth, but obedience to Divine Revelation.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: The great attraction of gluttony is not necessarily concerned with large quantities of food, but in the temptation to have just a 'little taste'. But if the wish for a taste succeeds in making you a slave to gluttony, the Evil One can then give you up utterly to destruction.

Author: St. Basil the Great
Quote: And because of anger, tongues become unbridled and speech unguarded. Physical violence...is born of anger....Anger is a kind of momentary madness, for its victims...do not rest until they have either inflicted some hurt or are themselves injured.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: God often allows us to hit rock bottom so that we will discover that He is the rock at the bottom.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: When a person receives communion, the grace of Communion extends to his entire family, both the living and the dead.

Author: St. Symeon the New Theologian
Quote: It is impossible to fill the body to satiety with food and at the same time have spiritual enjoyment of mental and Divine blessings. For inasmuch as a man panders to his belly, in the same measure he deprives himself of spiritual blessings; conversely, in proportion as he keeps his body lean, he will be filled with spiritual food and consolation.

Author: St. Ephraim of Katounakia
Quote: [When you say the Jesus Prayer] think of yourself as in a port and right then a ship is departing and in that ship is Christ and all the Church. What will you do? Won't you let out a yell, with all your might: 'Lord Jesus Christ have mercy on me!' That is how we should pray—with such strength of our soul.

Author: St. Porphyrios of Kafsokalyvia
Quote: A person can become a saint anywhere. ... Look on all things as opportunities to be sanctified.

Author: St. Seraphim of Sarov
Quote: Even if a person is sinful to such a degree that he is black from head to toe, if he approaches the Holy Chalice with a sense of universal repentance, he will gradually be cleaned, whitened, enlightened, and by God's grace will be purified and saved.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: And all men are ready to pass judgement on the priest as if he was not a being clothed with flesh, or one who inherited a human nature.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: It is only next to God that we can find true and eternal joy. We taste bitter poison when we live apart from sweet Jesus.

Author: St. Makarios the Great
Quote: Most wish to obtain the kingdom and desire to have eternal life but following their own wills. They refuse to control them. They are rather more like a shower whose sows vain desires. They refuse to deny themselves and still wish to receive eternal life - which is impossible.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: When anger comes, close your mouth tightly. Do not speak to him who curses, dishonors, reproaches, or bothers you in any way without reason…

Author: St. Ambrose
Quote: When I am at Rome I fast at the Romans do; when I am at Milan I do not fast. So likewise, you, whatever church you come to, observe the custom of the place, if you would neither give offense to others, nor take offense from them.

Author: St. Gennadios Scholarios
Quote: Never speak ill of your brother. This is much worse than judging him, for he who judges pollutes his own soul, violently overturning the divine order, while he who speaks ill murder his brother with the knife of his tongue. No knife is sharper than an evil tongue.

Author: Fr. Paul Truebenbach
Quote: Stop searching for the right person, only worry about being the right person. Let God worry about finding the right person for you. Focus on you. The more our hearts are filled with desire to become Saints, the less anxiety we have about these things.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: The Lord has taken all our cares upon Himself, and He said He will provide for all our needs. Yet, we hold on to our cares to tightly that we create unrest in our hearts and minds. Only those who leave everything to God can escape this emptiness.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: Guard your mind, and you will not be harassed by temptations. But if you fail to guard it, accept patiently whatever trial comes.

Author: Elder Hieronymus of Aegina
Quote: Entrust everything to God's hands and do not worry about the future. What will be beneficial and saving for you, the Lord will send.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: If the Holy Spirit is peace of soul, as He is said to be, and as He is in reality, and if anger is disturbance of heart, as it actually is and is said to be, then nothing so prevents His presence in us as anger.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: ...The three movements that lead to passion: The first is a natural movement, inherent in the body, which does not produce anything sinful, but merely lets it be known that it exists in the body—such as hunger. The second kind of movement in the body is produced by too much food and drink, which stimulates the body to fight against the soul, urging it towards sin. The third movement comes from evil spirits who try to tempt and weaken us.

Author: Our Lord
Quote: I took you from the ends of the earth, from its farthest corners I called you. I said, ‘You are my servant’; I have chosen you and have not rejected you. So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: [Gentleness is achieved] by continually counting our sins, and by mourning and weeping over them. We mourn because wherever there is mourning it is impossible for there to be anger. The mind, when scourged by sorrow, does not have the leisure to be roused.

Author: St. Ambrose of Optina
Quote: If you do good, you must do it only for God. For this reason, you must pay no attention to the ingratitude of people.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: When someone offends you, pray for them, it's medicine for your soul.

Author: St. Seraphim Romantsov
Quote: Condemnation of one's neighbors is a spiritual weakness and not a paltry thing. The one who condemns shares responsibility with the one who is being condemned.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: There is no better way to teach a child Christianity than to live it truly and from the heart. You cannot teach what you do not live.

Author: St. Justin Popovich
Quote: He who has no love cannot be called a Christian... The whole Gospel is summarized in compassion. And this secures immortality and eternal life to man.

Author: Abba Poemen
Quote: There is no greater love than that a man lays down his life for his neighbor. When you hear someone complaining and you struggle with yourself and do not answer him back with complaints; when you are hurt and bear it patiently, not looking for revenge; then you are laying down your life for your neighbor.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: If a man doesn't start to work on himself, then the devil will find another job for him: to seek for flaws in others.

Author: Abba Evagrius
Quote: [Anger is often useful because it is] ...by nature designed for waging war with demons and for struggling with every kind of sin....It is the demons, who entice us towards worldly lusts, that make us use anger to fight with men.

Author: St. John of The Cross
Quote: Cast your care upon God for you are His and He will not forget you.

Author: Elder Iliy Nozdrin
Quote: Everyone judges others by the measure of their own immorality.

Author: St. Macarius of Optina
Quote: Watch out for complaining. It only makes situations worse and increases sorrows.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Do not believe your thoughts, neither when they tell you that you are terrible, nor when they tell you that you are a saint.

Author: Abbess Aemiliane
Quote: The neighbor that gives us daily crosses is a handpicked, hand wrapped, and hand delivered gift from God.

Author: St. Nectarios of Aegina
Quote: Do not be upset when people only remember you when they need you. Feel privileged that you are like a candle that comes to their mind during their darkest hours.

Author: Abba Agathon
Quote: Anytime you are tempted to judge, remember this: nothing is outside the mercy of God.

Author: St. Porphyrios of Kavoskalyvia
Quote: Every time you forgive someone, you crucify your ego and resurrect your soul.

Author: St. Luke of Crimea
Quote: If you're not sick, if you're not suffering—it's not because you're so lucky, it's because God calls you to share in the suffering of others! You must be eyes for the blind, ears for the deaf, legs for the same. You must be a helper to the disabled, to people who cannot move themselves, so that the Love of Christ can be seen in this ministry.

Author: St. Gregory of Nyssa
Quote: May we never risk the life of our souls by being resentful or by bearing grudges.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: Do not be surprised if you fall every day; do not give up, but stand your ground courageously. And assuredly, the angel that guards you will honor your patience.

Author: St. Joseph of Optina
Quote: As much as possible, be quiet.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: We don't pursue hardships but if they come we face them with steadfastness and prayer.

Author: Abba Ephiphanius
Quote: Reading the scriptures is a great safeguard against sin.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: A person’s spiritual state is indicated by the quality of his thoughts. People judge things according to their heart’s spiritual content. If they do not have spiritual content, they will draw the wrong conclusions and do wrong to other people.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: A man becomes spiritual when he recognizes his own sins more than the sins of others.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: God gives every person a cross according to his strength. God gives a person a cross not so that he would suffer, but s o that from the cross he would rise up to heaven.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: The spirits of evil watch closely to see whether we pay attention to our dreams or not. They know what kind of influence dreams have on an individual and what they can do to trigger that influence. If they see that we believe in our dreams in our living apprehension as to what we see in our dreams, then, they will arrange for things from our dreams to happen, so that eventually we will lose touch with reality and become incapable of living.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: [Until] our will consents, these thoughts constitute neither virtue nor vice, but merely disclose the inclination of our will.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: The Jesus Prayer must gratefully and generously spring out of our soul, while, at the same time, we think of all the good things God has done for us.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: A new idea began to enter my awareness: that Truth was not just an abstract idea, sought and known by the mind, but was something personal—even a Person—sought and loved by the heart. And that is how I met Christ.

Author: St. Ignatius Brianchaninov
Quote: Whatever you do, on no account condemn anyone; do not even try to judge whether a person is good or bad, but keep your eyes on that one evil person for whom you must give an account before God—yourself.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: The one who has achieved love has cast out revenge, but the one who nourishes a feeling of ill-will amasses never-ending misery for himself.

Author: Bishop Gherasim of Putna
Quote: Weeping for God makes you happier than you can imagine. A spiritual father once said: 'You see God better through tears.'

Author: Fr. Christopher
Quote: We live in times when everything must happen 'now...' Impatience has become second nature to us, quietly stealing our inner peace. Yet, Christ calls us to something else: patience. Patience is not passivity; it is a powerful spiritual work. It keeps us anchored in the hope that God is at work even when we see nothing. It makes us gentler with our neighbor, wiser with our words, more steadfast in prayer. Patience is a daily cross, but also a sure path to salvation. Today...whisper in your heart: 'Lord, help me to endure!'

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: Be the friend of all, but in your spirit remain alone.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: Every sin that is left without repentance is a sin unto death, for which even if a saint shall pray, he shall not be heard.

Author: Kallistos Ware
Quote: [Orthodox] Christianity is more than a theory about the universe, more than teachings written down on paper; it is a path along which we journey—in the deepest and richest sense, the way of life.

Author: St. Seraphim Rose
Quote: Orthodoxy alone continues to produce saints—I mean real saints, not just 'good men.'

Author: St. Iakovos of Evia
Quote: If you leave Orthodoxy because of a bad priest, you never joined because of Christ.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Let no one mourn that he has fallen again and again; for forgiveness has risen from the grave.

Author: St. Amphilochios of Patmos
Quote: Do not be afraid because of your Orthodoxy; because as an Orthodox Christian in the West, you will often be isolated and always in a small minority. Do not make compromises, but not do attack other Christians. Be neither defensive nor aggressive. Simply be yourself.

Author: St. Paisie
Quote: Humility is stronger than any atomic weapon.

Author: St. Gabriel Urgebadze
Quote: The time will come when evil will become law. But don't be afraid. He who is with God is stronger than all armies. And if the world is collapsing do not fall away from faith. And in the darkness there will be light, if your heart is with Christ.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: God's help can't be obstructed, neither by men nor demons.

Author: Abba Isidore The Priest
Quote: If you fast regularly, do not be inflated with pride, but if you think highly of yourself because of it, then you had better eat meat. It is better for a man to eat meat than to be inflated with pride and to glorify himself.

Author: St. Ephraim of Arizona
Quote: Those who say the Jesus Prayer will overcome what comes with God's help.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Use your komboschoini all the time, until your spiritual oil warms up and the spiritual engine starts, so that the heart works at the prayer by itself.

Author: St. Joseph the Hesychast
Quote: Say the Jesus Prayer constantly, and the Lord will help you with His grace. Temptations are never stronger than grace.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: If you cannot find Christ in the beggar at the church door, you will not find Him in the chalice.

Author: Elder Sergei of Vanves
Quote: When you feel that you are falling into confusion or despair, stop yourself immediately and repent of it, as you would for a sin, and get back on your feet.

Author: Fr. Spyridon Morris
Quote: If prayer comes easily, that's a gift from God to you. If prayer is a struggle and a chore, it's a gift from you to God.

Author: St. Barsanuphius of Optina
Quote: A humble sinner is more pleasing to the Lord than a righteous man who is proud.

Author: Abbess Theosemni
Quote: All our difficulties occur so that we can learn to be patient and tolerant in all things.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: You will receive as much love as you offer. If you do not give love, you will not receive love. Look at a mother: she constantly offers he love to her children; she constantly receives love from them in return, so her love becomes ever increasing.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Where there is love, there is great security and God's great blessing. Love is the mother of all blessings, their root and source; it is the end of wars and the extermination of strife.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: All works are not equal, the scriptures said that Abraham was hospitable, and God was with him. And, Elijah loved quiet, and God was with him. And, David was humble, and God was with him. What therefore you find that your soul desires in following God, that do and keep your heart.

Author: St. Anatoly of Optina
Quote: He who has no humility has no salvation—even if he raises the dead.

Author: St. Theophan the Recluse
Quote: He who sits long in the sun warms his body; thus, he who always contemplates God and divine things warms his spirit.

Author: St. Augustine
Quote: Let us understand that God is a physician, and that suffering is a medicine for salvation, not a punishment for damnation.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: We must not mind insulting men, if by respecting them we offend God.

Author: St. Paul the Apostle
Quote: I have been crucified with Christ; it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself for me.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: A proud monk needs no demon. He has turned into one, an enemy to himself.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: In order to to abide in the love of God it is essential for anger and 'hate' to attain their maximum intensity but be directed against the sin that lives in me, against the evil active in me—in me, not in my brother.

Author: Archimandrite Athanasios
Quote: The best sleeping pills are two: one, a clear conscience—your conscience shouldn’t trouble you for any evil you have done; two, faith in God’s providence—trust that God will take care of everything.

Author: J.R.R. Tolkien
Quote: I have found that it is the small everyday deed of ordinary folks that keep the darkness at bay. Small acts of kindness and love.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: If you have time to dress elegantly, to eat, to gossip with neighbors, to run after markets and shows—and then you claim you have no time to pray or to give alms—you are lying! Your time reveals what you truly love.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: Do not disdain those who are deformed from birth, because all of us will go to the grave equally privileged.

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: Therefore... Let us awake from sleep, while we are still in the body. Let us sigh and mourn over ourselves from our whole heart, day and night.

Author: St. Isaac of Syria
Quote: Fasting is the mother of all virtues, and through it we learn self-control and the mastery of passions.

Author: St. Johny Chrysostom
Quote: Tell your wife that you love her more than your own life, because this present life is nothing, and that your only hope is that the two of you pass through this life in such a way that in the world to come, you will be united in perfect love.

Author: St. Symeon the New Theologian
Quote: An argumentative man is like someone who consciously gives himself up to his enemies....[If] a man is deeply wounded in his heart by provocation and abuse...and therefore argues with bitterness or speaks with arrogance, he will give the serpent added strength to pour poison into his heart and mercilessly devour his entrails. Thereupon the man will live for sin and become totally dead to truth.

Author: St. Amphilochios of Patmos
Quote: God is visiting you when tears come during prayer.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Do you think that He who numbers the hairs on your head does not know the measure of your suffering? Yes, He knows it, therefore be at rest, trusting in our Heavenly Father.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: To the degree that we let go of our worldly cares, the Lord allows us to feel that He is with us. The Lord is peace, joy; He is father, mother, and friend to us. We have everything in Him. He is the One Who satisfies the needs of the soul.

Author: St. Paisios the Athonite
Quote: Do not envy people that have money, comforts, fame and power, but rather those who live with virtue, reason, and piety.

Author: Gerondissa Makrina Vassopoulou
Quote: Those young people who preserve their purity will have in the next life the grace of the ancient Confessors

Author: St. Sebastian of Optina
Quote: A Guardian Angel is given to each person at baptism... Let us be attentive towards our Guardian Angel... and not disgrace him by our actions.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: Why not learn to enjoy the little things—there are so many of them.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: The Church is a hospital, not a courtroom, for souls. She does not condemn on behalf of sins, but grants remission of sins.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: If you've come to the Church to find holy people, you've made a mistake. If you came to find God, you chose correctly.

Author: St. John of Kronstadt
Quote: …If you only pray when you want to, you will completely cease praying… You will not workout your salvation without forcing yourself.

Author: St. John Climacus
Quote: Before the fall, the demons call God merciful. But after the fall, they call Him harsh.

Author: Abba Evagrius
Quote: Anger is the quickest passion of all. It is aroused and inflamed against a man who has done, or seems to have done, one an injury. It hardens the soul ever more and more.

Author: St. Mark of Ephesus
Quote: Nothing is equal to or superior to Orthodoxy

Author: St. Anthony the Great
Quote: Do good to one who wrongs you, and God will be your friend.

Author: St. Mark the Ascetic
Quote: He who has been baptized into Christ has already been given grace. But this grace acts in proportion to the degree that he follows the commandments. Although this grace never ceases to help us in secret, it lies in our power, in our will, to do or not to do good. This grace fittingly arouses our conscience...Also, this grace may be concealed in the advice of a brother. Sometimes it teaches us truth through pious reading.

Author: St. Maximos the Confessor
Quote: If you have faith in the Lord you will fear punishment, and this fear will lead you to control the passions. Once you control the passions you will accept affliction patiently, and through such acceptance you will acquire hope in God.

Author: St. Isaac the Syrian
Quote: Above anything, welcome silence, for it brings fruits that no tongue can speak of, neither can it be explained.

Author: St. Gregory the Theologian
Quote: Good if not done in a good way, is not good.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: If you knew how quickly people will forget you when you die, you would not seek to please anyone but God.

Author: St. Porphyrios
Quote: Your constant care should be not to let your heart become agitates or troubled, but to use every effort to keep it peaceful and calm. Seeing your efforts and endeavors, God will send you His grace and will make your soul a city of peace.

Author: St. Nektarios of Aegina
Quote: Everyday you should try to plant something spiritual in your soul which replaces something worldly...replace songs with hymns, worldly reading with spiritual books, sinful images with holy ones.

Author: St. Tikhon of Zadonsk
Quote: The Christian life is nothing more than daily repentance until the end of one's life.

Author: St. John Chrysostom
Quote: If we offer prayers to God for those who offend and insult us, then our prayer for ourselves will also be heard.

Author: St. Gregory of Sinai
Quote: Anger is tamed and becomes transformed into gentleness only by courage and mercy.

Author: St. Moses the Black
Quote: To live with Jesus you need—struggle, humility and unceasing prayer. These are your tools for the hard road ahead.

Author: St. Iakovos of Evia
Quote: My Children, no one should have any doubts or mistrusts. Have faith in God as a sinewy grain, and whatever you ask from God, He will give it to you. Prayer always supports us. Let us not be afraid. If God is with us, no one can be against us.

Author: St. Nektarios of Aegina
Quote: Do not despair if you keep falling into old sins. Many of them are strong because they have received the force of habit.

Author: St. Ephraim of Katounakia
Quote: Man, especially today, is seeking for a compassionate heart.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: It seems that we do not understand one thing: it is not good when we return the love of those who love us, yet hate those who hate us. We are not on the right path if we do this. We are the sons of light and love, the sons of God, his children. As such we must have His qualities and His attributes of love, peace, and kindness towards all.

Author: Gerondissa Makrina of Volos
Quote: Like an enormous ocean, like great rivers and valleys, may the Lord grant us so much patience.

Author: Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica
Quote: We do not need to say anything or do anything, but we feel so good in the presence of a humble and meek person who is full of love and goodness. He does not have to say anything either, yet he radiates warmth, and it is as though we have caught a chill and have come into a warm and pleasant room and it warms us. You see, that is the meaning of good thoughts, good desires full of love and goodness.

Author: St. Augustine
Quote: To fall in love with God is the greatest romance; to seek him the greatest adventure; to find him, the greatest human achievement.

Author: St. Silouan the Athonite
Quote: If your bother is your enemy, then the devil is your friend.
